subject.title: fix(heartbeat): remove static iteration cap in seekNextActivePhaseDueMs

question: Should OpenClaw merge this bounded batch/backward-walk active-hours seek as the supported behavior for accepted heartbeat intervals below one minute?
rationale: Current config parsing accepts ms and second-level heartbeat intervals, and this PR changes both scheduling behavior and synchronous predicate-call budget for those existing inputs.

options.title: Merge Bounded Seek
options.body: Accept the upgrade-visible scheduling change and land after exact-head checks are fresh enough for the maintainer.

options.title: Ask For Timing Proof
options.body: Request one more production-path timing transcript for a very small interval crossing into active hours before merge.

options.title: Pause For Interval Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to reject or constrain sub-minute heartbeat intervals instead of supporting them.

recommendation.title: Merge Bounded Seek
recommendation.body: Accept the upgrade-visible scheduling change and land after exact-head checks are fresh enough for the maintainer.
